Xe.bar_b_note: A's panel is on-palette and legible but generic; B's truncated recipe lines and tiny unglyphed hints sink it.

Yg.bar_b_note: A flat lawn and straight sand path dominate every camera; the gate is good but the sky realm and atmosphere never read.

Nb.bar_b_note: The domed aviary landmark carries it, but the grass carpet, muddy path smear and missing pale stone sink it.

Vd.bar_b_note: Strong hat-and-coat silhouette and warm palette carry it; waxy skin and shadowed eyes hold it back.

Sa.bar_b_note: Murky brown lighting, flat magenta telegraph decals, an unreadable player creature and (B) camera-in-foliage frames sink it.

Ql.bar_b_note: The fur model is close to the Tanglevolt bar, but A's floating faint poses and B's over-bright veins and nose-down faint end break the finish.

top_changes.change: Replace the uniform lawn on Cloudreach roads with pale stratified stone ledges, exposed rock, short alpine tufts and flower clumps, and break the straight path
Stormwood fight readability: keep the camera out of trunks and canopy, add the purple storm sky and creature rim light, and swap the flat magenta telegraph decals for lit ground cracks or sparks
Ground the creature faint poses so the body meets its shadow, and tone the lightning-vein emission down to the style-bar level
